purpose: Desktop announcements tag, blank source leather with live SVG/text lockup
selection: Variant 2 is the same stitched leather without baked raster lettering; live AnnouncementsLockup stays sharp at 240x88, accessible, themeable, and avoids double/raster-soft text.
crop_policy: Full leather body from both side edges through the lower stitched seam and rounded foot; no letterform pixels. Body is fitted above a retained soft contact-shadow strip so the edging and shadow are not clipped at 240x88.
alpha_mask: Source-derived leather silhouette with antialiased rounded lower corners; pale reference page removed. CSS terracotta remains visible below transparent pixels and if WebP loading fails.
fallback: CSS background-color #98401f paints immediately beneath the transparent WebP; the live SVG/text lockup remains DOM content.
